name: Jira
description: Your Jira Cloud issues in lanes (Backlog, In progress, Mentioned, On hold, Done), unread marks, sorted by Jev triage, discussed with Claude. Comments and status changes from a reply page; ccc jira update drafts them for you to post (or writes directly, or is off: a setting with a per-project override). Provides the jira service (issue status, the issue view) to other plugins, such as bronos.gmail, and an inbox-feed of your issues for Inbox. Needs cc-cockpit 0.10.1 or later for ccc jira update.
author: BronOS
